newsitem.title: FRANCE: HORSE RACING-SPINNING WORLD WINS FOR SECOND TIME.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-SPINNING WORLD WINS FOR SECOND TIME.

text.p: Spinning World dominated the closing stages of the group one Prix Jacques Le Marois on Sunday to win for the second consecutive year.
The winner, ridden by Cash Asmussen, is owned by the Niarchos family who also sponsor the race.
Second place went to the Aga Khan-owned Daylami with Neuilly third.
British challengers have a poor record in the race, and although Frankie Dettori's mount Starborough started favourite, he faded to finish fourth of the six starters.
